milestones.title: M1: Core protocol compatibility
milestones.description: Complete when the supported Windows core protocol matches the panel contract and live TLS console/file workflows have been verified. Local tests alone do not satisfy the live gate.

tasks.title: Correct file listing URL, metadata and content headers
Enforce and refresh Windows egg file restrictions
Derive authoritative startup, allocation and timezone variables
Make emergency kill interrupt and cancel power operations
Match suspended start and restart HTTP responses
Add independent upstream and panel contract fixtures
Support opted-in Windows egg readiness and stop configuration
tasks.notes: Supported scope: multiple literal/regex readiness matchers, ANSI stripping, stdin commands and explicit SIGKILL. Unsupported signals/native Docker stop and config rewrites fail explicitly; they are not silently emulated.

tasks.title: Apply live job resource limits during panel sync
tasks.notes: Verify applied Windows Job Object CPU/memory limits, removal of caps, local cap retention and no process restart. Reject failed updates without claiming new enforcement.

tasks.title: Match power wait_seconds and remaining operation locking
Complete system information, HTTP preflight and request errors
Verify real panel TLS, console, subuser revocation and file workflows
tasks.notes: Live verification gate: record actual panel/Windows versions and results; do not close using mock-panel tests. Alpha51 real panel follow-up: 12 Application and 18 Client/panel-issued-token checks pass for bounded demo lifecycle, files, signed transfers, WSS/power/console. Browser UI, actual subuser removal, real game and broader semantics/recovery remain open. Evidence: https://github.com/SturdyStubs/Wings-for-Windows/blob/main/docs/evidence/server2022-alpha51-real-panel-apis.md

tasks.title: Verify live HTTPS node authentication and demo browser console
tasks.notes: Acceptance: authenticated trusted HTTPS system requests and an operator-reported real demo browser console with state events, streamed readiness and command echo. Both pass. This does not accept panel file UI, real subuser removal, browser reconnect or complete M1 validation. Evidence: https://github.com/SturdyStubs/Wings-for-Windows/blob/main/docs/evidence/server2022-alpha42-live-operations.md

milestones.title: M2: Isolation and threat model
milestones.description: Required before public or mutually untrusted hosting claims. Define and verify the supported Windows isolation model.

tasks.title: Choose Windows native identities versus container or VM isolation
tasks.notes: Architecture decision in docs/ISOLATION.md only. Native identity enforcement and virtualization are not implemented; other M2 gates remain open.

tasks.title: Separate daemon credentials and enforce filesystem and network policies
Test cross-server access, hardlinks, aliases, reparse points and races
Publish and verify supported host, runtime and game matrix
Verify managed non-administrator service and separate demo identity
tasks.notes: Acceptance: real Server 2022 managed non-administrator daemon/service and a separate game account with approved profile and daemon-context credential; demo install/start/console/stop pass. Account/task access-denial checks and deliberate password rotation are recorded in live-operations evidence. WFP, hostile cross-server races and complete isolation remain in the original open tasks. Evidence: https://github.com/SturdyStubs/Wings-for-Windows/blob/main/docs/evidence/server2022-alpha42-live-demo.md

milestones.title: M3: Provisioning and recovery
milestones.description: Complete a real supported Windows game's entire panel-managed lifecycle, including installation and recovery.

tasks.title: Version Windows profiles and validate dependencies and OS requirements
tasks.notes: Schema v1, legacy migration, PE/architecture/OS-build and explicitly declared file checks before start/installation acknowledgement; offline CLI. Not automatic dependency resolution or game certification.

tasks.title: Implement create, delete, install and reinstall with cancellation and callbacks
tasks.notes: Alpha51 real panel follow-up: 12 Application and 18 Client/panel-issued-token checks pass for bounded demo lifecycle, files, signed transfers, WSS/power/console. Browser UI, actual subuser removal, real game and broader semantics/recovery remain open. Evidence: https://github.com/SturdyStubs/Wings-for-Windows/blob/main/docs/evidence/server2022-alpha51-real-panel-apis.md

tasks.title: Implement egg text, JSON, YAML, INI, properties and XML config parsers
Add crash recovery, persistent logs and interrupted-operation recovery
Add Windows control-event, log-tail and game console adapters
Verify a real game from creation through installation and deletion
tasks.notes: Live gate: create, install, start, stop/restart, reinstall and delete from the panel.

tasks.title: Verify manually approved demo creation and live install callback lifecycle
tasks.notes: Acceptance: operator-created real panel record awaits local approval, approved native demo installation calls back to the real panel, marker reads and API start/console/stop pass. This is a harmless demo and manual approval; real games, automatic account/profile provisioning and deletion remain open. Evidence: https://github.com/SturdyStubs/Wings-for-Windows/blob/main/docs/evidence/server2022-alpha42-live-demo.md

milestones.title: M4: Files and SFTP
milestones.description: Complete the file manager and SFTP with permissions, streaming, confinement and storage accounting.

tasks.title: Implement remaining file operations and scoped large-file upload/download
tasks.notes: Alpha51 real panel follow-up: 12 Application and 18 Client/panel-issued-token checks pass for bounded demo lifecycle, files, signed transfers, WSS/power/console. Browser UI, actual subuser removal, real game and broader semantics/recovery remain open. Evidence: https://github.com/SturdyStubs/Wings-for-Windows/blob/main/docs/evidence/server2022-alpha51-real-panel-apis.md

tasks.title: Add safe archives and guarded remote fetch with cancellation
tasks.notes: Alpha 47 creates tar.gz; alpha 48 extracts it; alpha 49 adds opt-in guarded HTTPS pulls; alpha 50 adds bounded ZIP Store/Deflate extraction. 1340 local / 14 native / 133 portable extraction / 16 live groups plus upload/WSS regressions pass. Browser workflows, broader formats/merge/fetch policies, progress UI, quotas and durable recovery remain open; broad task not complete. Evidence: https://github.com/SturdyStubs/Wings-for-Windows/blob/main/docs/evidence/server2022-alpha50-zip-extraction.md

tasks.title: Implement SFTP authentication, permissions, revocation and limits
Enforce storage accounting across file, archive, installer and game writes
tasks.notes: Alpha 51 adds cached asynchronous logical data-root measurement in server/console stats, with bounded guarded scans and explicit stale/error status. 1360 local / 14 native / 19 scanner-cache / one API case and six live disk groups pass, plus extraction/upload/WSS regressions. Measurement is not quota enforcement; allocated space, alternate streams, reservations and enforcement across all writers remain open. Evidence: https://github.com/SturdyStubs/Wings-for-Windows/blob/main/docs/evidence/server2022-alpha51-disk-usage.md

tasks.title: Verify locked files, long paths, disk-full, archives and link attacks
Implement and verify bounded directory, rename and regular-file copy operations
tasks.notes: Acceptance: bounded upstream directory creation, file/directory rename and regular-file copy contracts, Windows regression/portable suites and non-administrator SCM/game access. These pass, with subsequent live file API checks in live-operations evidence. Deletion, broader semantics, large scoped transfer, browser file UI, SFTP and quotas remain in open parent deliverables. Evidence: https://github.com/SturdyStubs/Wings-for-Windows/blob/main/docs/evidence/server2022-alpha42-file-copy.md

tasks.title: Implement and verify bounded handle-pinned file and directory deletion
tasks.notes: Bounded files/trees only; whole-batch pinning/policy preflight, late-child preservation and partial outcomes. 985 local / 14 native / 40 portable / 8 live checks pass. Browser controls, quotas, full semantics and server-record deletion remain open. Evidence: https://github.com/SturdyStubs/Wings-for-Windows/blob/main/docs/evidence/server2022-alpha44-file-delete.md

tasks.title: Implement and verify bounded one-use signed file downloads
tasks.notes: Bounded JWT/path/replay/streaming checks: 1027 local / 14 native / 42 portable / 10 live HTTPS / 10 WSS regressions. Tokens are synthetic operator fixtures; actual panel browser links, subuser removal, uploads, resume and full transfer scope remain open. Evidence: https://github.com/SturdyStubs/Wings-for-Windows/blob/main/docs/evidence/server2022-alpha45-signed-downloads.md

tasks.title: Implement and verify bounded one-use multipart uploads
tasks.notes: Scoped acceptance: 1079 local / 14 native / 52 portable upload / 10 live upload-service-cleanup / 10 download / 10 WSS regressions. Retained service 9 MiB and public small uploads pass; public 9 MiB remains proxy-limited (413). Browser-issued links, real subuser removal, overwrite/resume, quotas, SFTP and durable staging recovery remain in open parent gates. Evidence: https://github.com/SturdyStubs/Wings-for-Windows/blob/main/docs/evidence/server2022-alpha46-signed-uploads.md

milestones.title: M5: Backups and transfers
milestones.description: Complete verified backups, restore and native-to-native transfers with recovery and integrity checks.

tasks.title: Implement local and S3 backups, exclusions, checksums and downloads
Implement safe restore, operation locking and completion events
Implement source/destination transfer, integrity, cancel and rollback
Verify interruption recovery and restore and boot a real game
tasks.notes: Live gate: the restored game must actually boot and retain expected data.

milestones.title: M6: Operations and validation
milestones.description: Complete operational support and deployment validation on the explicitly supported Windows/panel matrix.

tasks.title: Add aggregate metrics, disk/network accounting and affinity
Enforce allocations, networking, shared mounts and supported limit mappings
Implement runtime config, credential rotation, audit delivery and retries
Add diagnostics, service logs, certificate renewal, upgrade checks and CI
Verify multi-server load, Windows Server service/reboot and panel versions
tasks.notes: Live gate: record versions, sustained-load results, SCM/reboot/upgrade and real panel behavior.

tasks.title: Implement pinned reverse SSH supervision and verify child-exit reconnection
tasks.notes: Acceptance: isolated key/known-hosts directory, strict pinned-host batch SSH supervisor, startup task registration and successful authenticated HTTPS recovery after forced SSH-child exit. All pass. Boot recovery, long outages, changed keys, monitoring and complete operational certification remain open. Evidence: https://github.com/SturdyStubs/Wings-for-Windows/blob/main/docs/evidence/server2022-alpha42-live-operations.md

tasks.title: Support explicit operator-managed configuration update acknowledgements
tasks.notes: Acceptance: opt-in authenticated bounded POST /api/update returns applied:false without changing native configuration or credentials; local, portable VM and retained-service live checks pass. Remote apply/token rotation, audit retries and panel save-button confirmation remain open. Evidence: https://github.com/SturdyStubs/Wings-for-Windows/blob/main/docs/evidence/server2022-alpha43-config-policy.md
